pages.text: The $(l)Dipping Vat$() turns a plain $(l)Glass Vial$() arrow into a $(l)potion arrow$(). Fill the vat with any potion, dip an empty glass-vial arrow, and it comes out tipped with that effect.
Craft a Dipping Vat to tip your arrows.
On hit, the vial $(l)shatters$() and splashes its potion onto whatever it struck: a delivery system for anything you can brew, from Healing to Poison to Slow Falling.
